ModMetaData.name: Earned Experience
ModMetaData.author: ArliT1-F
ModMetaData.description: Expands vanilla skill progression by awarding XP for meaningful work that normally gives no experience — stonecutting, smelting, cleaning, hauling, refueling, trap rearming, cremation, firefighting and patient care. XP is proportional to actual work performed, respects passions and learning limits, and is fully configurable per-activity. Feels like vanilla. Supported activities: stonecutting, smelting (weapons/apparel), cleaning, hauling, transport loading, refueling, trap rearming, cremation, firefighting, patient care (feeding). See included Technical Report for verification of vanilla XP gaps.
ModMetaData.descriptionShort: Award skill XP for useful work that vanilla overlooks — stonecutting, hauling, cleaning and more.
